description: Sample payloads for testing the Issue Alert Automation Workflow
usage: Send these via curl or import into Postman to test the webhook

body.title: API failure detected
body.description: Main API endpoint returning 500 errors for 5+ minutes

body.title: Unauthorized access attempt detected
body.description: Multiple failed login attempts from IP 192.168.1.100

body.title: Dashboard loading slowly
body.description: Average page load time increased to 8 seconds

body.title: Non-critical test flake in CI
body.description: Intermittent test failure in logging module

curl_examples.high_priority: curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/issue-alert -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title": "API failure detected", "priority": "high", "source": "monitoring"}'
curl_examples.low_priority: curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/issue-alert -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title": "Minor UI glitch", "priority": "low", "source": "user_report"}'
curl_examples.python_backend_direct: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/process-alert -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title": "API failure detected", "priority": "high", "source": "monitoring"}'
